description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Change Machinery Mode III (Fire, Lightning, Poison)], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Bravo Shot Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Hexa Boost
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (0.90 each), grants [Machinist +30% Boost 1] to the user

description.name: Royal Courage
description.text: Three single ranged attacks (0.90 each), causes [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)], [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)] every second activation if Sabin and Relm are not alive, causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)] every second activation if Sabin or Relm are alive, grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Change Machinery Mode III (Fire, Lightning, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Lightning/Poison ability

description.name: Bravo Shot Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Bravo Shot after using three of Hexa Boost or Royal Courage

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
